a.xlink:title: Person 1 -- * PersonRoleA PersonRole has A Person. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one Person.A Person has some PersonRoles. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When a PersonRole is created, its Person must be assigned. When a PersonRole is deleted, its Person is not deleted and its list of PersonRoles is decreased. When a Person is deleted, its PersonRoles are not deleted. They are assigned to another Person.
